args.title: Brightline Freight: Retail Returns Logistics — Summary
args.body:
- Brightline Freight's latest newsletter focuses on retail returns logistics, linking to their main article on the topic.
- Per the article: apparel return rates have reached 24%, and consolidating return hubs cut handling costs by a fifth (~20%).
- Per the companion piece: reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin.
